flags.reason: The Segmented Control guide (3f56271) never says when to use Tabs instead, and the Tabs guide doesn't name Segmented Control. This rule's pointer to Tabs rests on the unpublished upstream SegmentedControl.mdx as the evidence records it (“prefer Tabs for peer views”); at dbe0e02f the mdx still says the control “filters or switches a value in place” while Tabs “switch peer views or pages” (lines 24 and 84). But the guide's own Three options card calls “a period or a view with three choices” the usual case, and the Tabs guide offers Tabs “to switch between a few peer views of the same content”, so from the published guides alone a designer or agent can't tell whether switching views belongs to this control or to Tabs. The guide should say when to use Tabs instead (and, as the mdx does, Segmented Track for a share-of chart and Chip Select for optional filters, which /avoidWhen/3 and /avoidWhen/4 also take from the mdx); then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r26, for Marcin to confirm. Guide fix #557.
